---The PDF Processing skill equips AI agents and assistants with a comprehensive toolkit to analyze, manipulate, and generate PDF documents. It bridges the gap between Python libraries (such as pypdf, pdfplumber, and ReportLab) and powerful CLI utilities (such as qpdf and poppler-utils) to automate complex document workflows.Core CapabilitiesText & Data Extraction: Extracts high-fidelity text and parses complex tables into machine-readable formats (like CSV, JSON, or pandas dataframes).Document Manipulation: Merges multiple files, splits documents into single pages, rotates pages, and adds watermarks.OCR & Scanned Documents: Utilizes tools like pytesseract to perform Optical Character Recognition (OCR) on scanned PDFs to make them fully searchable.Form Processing: Extracts form field data and programmatically fills out PDF forms.Document Generation: Programmatically creates dynamic, brand-compliant PDFs from scratch using templates, charts, and custom fonts.Security & Metadata: Encrypts/decrypts PDFs with passwords and extracts or updates document metadata.Use CasesUse this skill whenever you need to:Automate data entry by pulling financial data from PDF reports into Excel.Build batch processing scripts to merge and reorganize thousands of document pages.Generate dynamic PDF invoices, receipts, or certificates from application data.Quick ReferenceCommon tasks and their best tools include:TaskBest ToolCommand/CodeMerge PDFspypdfwriter.add_page(page)Extract Textpdfplumberpage.extract_text()Extract Tablespdfplumberpage.extract_tables()Create PDFsReportLabCanvas or PlatypusCommand Line Mergeqpdfqpdf --empty --pages ...For full deployment and configuration details, you can view the complete PDF Processing Reference Guide or check out the production-ready Davila7 PDF Processing Templates on GitHub.Would you like to know how to implement OCR on scanned PDFs, or do you need code snippets for generating custom PDFs?
